answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before earning, with slashing decided by random peer audit. A pearl is easy to fake alone, but a grove of independent auditors must each verify the work, and an orchard of honest agents quickly flags copies. Running a thousand fake identities then means a thousand stakes at risk and a thousand audit fees, so the cost of a Sybil farm grows linearly with its size while its reward stays capped per identity.
